content: RRF formula: score(c) = sum(1/(k+rank_i(c))) for each ranked list i. k=60 is empirically validated as optimal across datasets. rank is 1-based. Docs in only one list contribute score from that list only (zero from absent lists). Python: scores={};  for ranked_list in lists: for rank, doc_id in enumerate(ranked_list, start=1): scores[doc_id] = scores.get(doc_id, 0) + 1/(60+rank). Sort by score desc.
